```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```

Antibiotics 

```{r}

antibiotics <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")

ggplot( antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
  
)) + geom_line(colour = "red") +
   xlab("Year") +
   ylab("Antibiotic use by month") +
  ggtitle("Rate of total antibiotic consumption")
  
  
  



```
